claims.quote: The lesser bleeding heart tetra, Megalamphodus socolofi, is a characid known only from the rio Negro basin and the rio Nhamundá in Brazil.
Known only from the rio Negro basin in Amazonas state, Brazil, plus the rio Nhamundá, a smaller tributary drainage which enters the Amazon downstream of its confluence with the Negro.
